purpose: Represent the durable result/evidence of one Work Item run and make parent consumption/integration explicit.

fields.useful_delta: What now exists/was learned that did not before.
fields.facts: Evidence-grounded observations; keep distinct from recommendations.
fields.evidence: Tests, inspections, source refs and verification receipts.

consumption_rule: Return existence never implies integration or Human Acceptance. Parent/steward records a separate consumption/integration decision and updates Chat Object FOCUS/design/rules/work state as needed.
privacy_rule: Public return contains sanitized coordination/evidence only; private transcript/user payload stays outside public artifacts.
